{{Quote|The Rebels are moving a sizeable fleet in to this system. Their objective is to liberate the planet of the Trandoshans and our presence. We will of course stop their futile attempt.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:DyD" />}}
A failed '''Rebel Invasion of Kashyyyk''' took place in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] force led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] prevented [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] troops to land on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and liberate the planet

==Prelude==
{{Quote|To ensure that the pilots understand your supremacy, I'm providing you with my old star fighter. This weapon of destruction should instill fear and respect in both friend and foe.|Darth Vader, to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:DyD" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Rebel Alliance assembled a fleet and troops in order to invade and liberate the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] world of Kashyyyk from the Galactic Empire and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. However, unfortunately for the Alliance, the Empire discovered the plan right before the invasion started. Darth Vader, who was present on Kashyyyk at that moment, therefore gathered Imperial starfighters and [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to ambush the Rebel fleet. Vader did not participate in the battle himself but he provided his own [[Darth Vader's black Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] to an Imperial [[Ace/Legends|ace]] pilot who previously served under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Krieg]].<ref name="SWG:DyD" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|I will entrust you with leading our fleet to victory against the Rebels. Failure is not an option.|Darth Vader, to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:DyD" />}}
Although Imperial pilots had barely the time to take off and met in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], they were ready to fight when the Alliance starfighter jumped out [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] first arrived in the system. The surprise was total for the Rebel pilots who expected to attack Kashyyyk by surprise. In the ensuring battle, the Alliance suffered heavy casualties, particularly from the Imperial ace who piloted Vader's interceptor.<ref name="SWG:DaI" />

Rebel troop [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and support ships later arrived in the system, but they were soon joined by a group of Imperial [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]]. Due to the loss of most X-wings in the first stage of the battle, the Alliance starships were completely vulnerable to Imperial fighters and bombers. All the Rebel troops were killed in their transports before they could even approach the planet Kashyyyk. The battle ended when the remaining Alliance ships were destroyed.<ref name="SWG:FtJ" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Good, my faith in your abilities proved right.|Darth Vader, to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:FtJ" />}}
The destruction of the Rebel invasion force in space totally abolished any hope to liberate the world of Kashyyyk in the short-term.<ref name="SWG:FtJ" /> The Wookiee planet would only be [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|freed]] [[4 ABY/Legends|three years later]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel Invasion of Kashyyyk appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DaI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The battle was added to the game with the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|Rage of the Wookiees]]'' expansion pack, released on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:DaI" />
